title: Structure Overload
description: Transforms your Minecraft world into an endless sprawl of structures, spawning vanilla dungeons at every step without compromising game performance.
body:
Are you tired of traveling thousands of blocks just to find a single village or outpost? Structure Overload radically changes the rules of Minecraft generation, turning your world into an endless, densely packed landscape of ruins, cities, and dungeons.

Key Features:

_Extreme Generation Density:_ Structures are guaranteed to spawn in a tight 4x4 chunk grid. You will encounter new points of interest, loot, and dangers every few dozen blocks.

_The Ultimate Vanilla Pool:_ The mod includes absolutely every vanilla structure. Expect to constantly run into Woodland Mansions, Ancient Cities, Trial Chambers, Nether Fossils, End Cities, and beached Shipwrecks.

_Multi-Dimensional Support:_ The generation adapts to your environment. Explore an Overworld covered in temples, dive into the Nether to navigate endless Bastions, or conquer a sky filled with End Cities. The mod automatically calculates the perfect height for every structure in every dimension.
